fact.en: Do not confuse Mahavira as the founder of Jainism; he was the 24th Tirthankara (Restorer).
fact.hi: Do not confuse Mahavira as the founder of Jainism; he was the 24th Tirthankara (Restorer).

fact.en: Mahavira is often incorrectly associated with the same period as Buddha's Nirvana; remember their lifespans overlapped but were distinct.
